verdict.summary: The generated figure is a single-panel Panel C reproduction only; it omits Panels A and B and the bottom legend entirely. The Panel C model output itself is largely correct: exactly three smooth single-peaked direction-tuning curves over a variable-stimulus motion-direction axis (degrees, not contrast), low at both endpoints, with the correct vertical ordering (attend variable highest, fixation middle, attend nonpreferred lowest) maintained through the flanks, a clear legend distinguishing the three conditions, and a response y-axis label. The figure fails the structural items that require three labeled panels and the explanatory bottom legend, since only Panel C was produced. The core scientific reproduction target (Panel C ordering and shape) is satisfied.
